description: This source file manages associated WiFi devices, including harvesting, listing, and reporting device data for private and public WiFi networks. It includes functions for thread management, list handling, and WiFi data collection via system calls and external APIs.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeString
methods.description: Returns the current local time as a string.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeInSecond
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds since epoch.

methods.name: WaitForPthreadConditionTimeoutIDW
methods.description: Waits for a condition variable with a timeout based on polling period.

methods.name: isvalueinarray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array of ULONGs.

methods.name: SetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status and manages the harvesting thread accordingly.

methods.name: GetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Returns the current harvesting status.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period interval.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Returns the current reporting period.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period interval and signals the condition variable.

methods.name: ValidateIDWPeriod
methods.description: Validates if a given interval is within predefined acceptable periods.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Returns the current polling period.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Returns the default reporting period.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Returns the default polling period.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Returns the current TTL override value.

methods.name: SetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL override value.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Returns the default TTL override value.

methods.name: _syscmd
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output into a buffer.

methods.name: getTimeOffsetFromUtc
methods.description: Retrieves the device's time offset from UTC via system command.

methods.name: add_to_list
methods.description: Adds a device data entry to the linked list.

methods.name: print_list
methods.description: Prints the linked list of associated devices.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes and frees the linked list of associated devices.

methods.name: parseInputValue
methods.description: Parses a string to extract a specific numeric value (used for WiFi layer parsing).

methods.name: GetWiFiApGetAssocDevicesData
methods.description: Collects associated WiFi device data for a given SSID and updates internal lists.

methods.name: StartAssociatedDeviceHarvesting
methods.description: Main thread function for harvesting associated WiFi devices periodically.
